p: eyes: I kept my eyes from all wanton looks.
a maid: Would not God then have punished me?
the workers of iniquity: Job declares that the fear of God was a bridle to stay him from all wickedness.
integrity: He shows what his uprightness stands in, in as much as he was blameless before men and did not sin against the second table.
walked after mine eyes: That is, has accomplished the lust of my eyes.
eat: According to the curse of the law, De 28:33.
grind unto another: Let her be made a slave.
to destruction: He shows that although man neglects the punishment of adultery, yet the wrath of God will never cease till such are destroyed.
contended with me: When they thought themselves evil intreated by me.
God riseth up: If I had oppressed others, how would I have escaped God's judgment.
him: He was moved to show pity to servants, because they were God's creatures as he was.
to fail: By long waiting for her request.
as with a father: He nourished the fatherless, and maintained the widows cause.
up my hand against the fatherless: To oppress him and to do him harm.
arm fall from my shoulder blade: Let me rot in pieces.
terror to me: I did not refrain from sin for fear of men, but because I feared God.
sun when it shined: If I was proud of my worldly prosperity and happiness, which is meant by the shining of the sun, and brightness of the moon.
hand: If my own doings delighted me.
above: By putting confidence in anything but in him alone.
tabernacle said not: My servants moved me to be avenged of my enemy, yet I never wished him harm.
my transgressions as Adam: Not confessed it freely, by which it is evident that he justified himself before men, and not before God.
terrify me: That is, I reverenced the most weak and contemned and was afraid to offend them.
silence: I suffered them to speak evil of me, and went not out of my house to avenge it.
desire is: This is a sufficient token of my righteousness, that God is my witness and will justify my cause.
crown to me: Should not this book of his accusations be a praise and commendation to me?
prince would I go near unto: I will make him account of all my life, without fear.
cry against me: As though I had withheld their wages that laboured in it.
the owners thereof to lose their: Meaning, that he was not a briber or extortioner.
words of Job are ended: That is, the talk which he had with his three friends.
